c.v: Saves the current PC to Q0.
Saves the interrupt being responded to in Q1.
Jumps to the interrupt entry point (0x10).
After ULP-RISC-V enters the interrupt entry point, please save the context and use Q2 and Q3 as temporary storage registers for backup.
Before it exits the interrupt, restore the context.
Then, exit the interrupt by executing the retirq instruction and jump to Q0.
ULP does not support interrupt nesting and is not interrupted by any other interrupt before retirq is executed.
